## Chakra Engine - Content Pack Generator

### Flow:
1. Receive yacht_id via webhook
2. Fetch yacht data + assets
3. Claude: Creative strategy (angles, scripts, overlays)
4. OpenAI: Performance copy (hooks, captions, CTAs, hashtags)
5. QA Review (verify claims against source)
6. Save to database

### AI Architecture:
- Claude = Creative Director (style, emotion, storytelling)
- OpenAI = Performance Marketer (conversion, hooks, CTAs)
- Claude QA = Guardrails (fact-checking, brand compliance)
